findings.finding: Demo, Free, Start, Professional, Enterprise and Unified differ materially. Neural tracking, archive search, re-identification, integration, failover and private-cloud unification are license-dependent; several functions are country-restricted.
findings.uncertainty: Table establishes entitlement, not installed modules or measured performance.
findings.transfer_mechanism: Show actual available capabilities/configuration and explain absent prerequisites; never present the entire vendor catalogue as one proven product.

Unavailable review history is not represented as a valid empty history.
